card.one_sentence_claim: Treating each SPT-3G likelihood release as a distinct SBT lens f and the LambdaCDM+Sigma m_nu posterior as a packaged object E=U.f, the directional held-out cross-lens audit Delta-chi^2_{B|A} reproduces the DIRECTION of the reported neutrino-mass upper-bound tightening under the SPT2018->D1 swap and recasts it as a localizable, staging-controllable packaging-stability failure (large asymmetric mismatch ~2222 vs ~314, concentrated in TT high-ell ~2000-3000) -- with NO neutrino-sector physics produced.
card.target_known_fact: Reported tightening of cosmological summed-neutrino-mass 95% upper bounds when the CMB likelihood is swapped from SPT-3G 2018 TT/TE/EE to the later SPT-3G D1 release on essentially the same sky (SPT-only+DESI DR2: 0.194->0.085 eV; Planck-subset baseline+DESI: 0.080->0.068 eV), with the cross-lens disagreement localizing to TT high-ell (~2000-3000), as originally observed in arXiv:2601.16277.
card.scientific_domain: Cosmology / particle physics: cosmological inference of the summed neutrino mass from CMB+BAO likelihoods (SPT-3G, Planck, DESI DR2); pipeline/likelihood-stability diagnostics.

card.honest_status_note: FORCED-TARGET, derivability class C: SBT produces an audit FORM, not neutrino physics. (1) Direction-only: the reproduction matches the SIGN of the m_nu tightening but NOT the source magnitudes (reproduced SPT2018 baseline 0.080 eV vs source ~0.11 eV, line 463), and the two baselines disagree in shift size (0.109 eV vs 0.012 eV, lines 423/428); this is explicitly a directional replication of an already-reported empirical observation, not an explanation. (2) NO mass mechanism: no seesaw/Dirac, no PMNS matrix, no oscillation physics, no derivation of any m_nu value. (3) The empirical observation is imported from arXiv:2601.16277 (including the localization and the reprocessing diagnostic, which the paper explicitly disclaims as not novel, line 238). (4) The packaging-stability certificate (Foundations I D-IC-02/T-IC-02) is for deterministic partition lenses; its use on a stochastic compressed-likelihood lens is by analogy, not a discharged theorem (a MISSING-interface: no stochastic-lens backbone in the certified core, ledger line 111). (5) The only Lean-certified piece is the elementary truncated-Gaussian boundary lemma, which the paper itself calls inessential to the cosmological argument (line 512). (6) The genuinely new content -- directional Delta-chi^2 + localization + staging contract -- is reused from the dark-energy paper, not original to the neutrino setting. Honoring SBT disclaimer [153]: 'does not identify the pipeline root cause or establish a definitive m_nu value; dchi is a comparative diagnostic, not a calibrated p-value; P1 rewrite-mode is toy-only.'

opposite_world_test.explanation: SBT could 'retrodict' the opposite observation with identical machinery. (1) Direction of m_nu shift: the audit statistic Delta-chi^2_{B|A} = -2[logL_B(theta_A)-logL_B(theta_B)] is NON-NEGATIVE by construction (paper line 136) and completely sign-blind to whether the bound tightens or loosens. The 'direction of tightening' is read off the external Cobaya+CLASS/CAMB MCMC, to which SBT contributes nothing; had the D1 swap LOOSENED the 95% upper bound, the audit would report the same kind of large asymmetric mismatch and SBT would frame it identically as a packaging-stability failure. (2) Asymmetry: the celebrated 2222-vs-314 gap is just the two orderings of a guaranteed-positive quantity; a flipped asymmetry (314 vs 2222) is equally 'predicted'. (3) Localization: had the dominant block been TE/EE or low-ell rather than TT high-ell, the same per-block sum-rule decomposition would have flagged that region as the 'where to look' -- the localization simply re-displays whichever blocks the external likelihoods happen to disagree on (and it is itself imported from arXiv:2601.16277). (4) Staging: 'mismatch survives common-staging at the few-percent level' is a post-hoc qualitative read with no pre-registered threshold; any outcome (survives / is removed) is narratable. The mechanism cannot fail to fire whenever two releases differ at all, so it has essentially zero risk of being contradicted by data -- the hallmark of an unfalsifiable, flexibility-saturated retrodiction. SBT honestly labels this direction-only and forced-target, which is the correct verdict.

audit.audit_verdict: FORCED-TARGET / FLEXIBILITY-SATURATED (derivability class C), but HONESTLY SELF-LABELED. SBT produces an audit FORM (directional held-out Delta-chi^2 + per-block localization + common-staging control, reused from the dark-energy route-mismatch machinery), NOT neutrino physics. Estimated ~9 adjustable choices against ~1 genuinely matched data point: the SIGN of the m_nu tightening -- and even that sign comes from the imported external MCMC, not from any SBT quantity. Magnitudes are explicitly NOT matched (reproduced 0.080 eV vs source 0.11 eV; the two baselines disagree on shift size). The empirical observation, including the TT high-ell localization, is imported from arXiv:2601.16277 with disclaimed novelty. The packaging-stability certificate (D-IC-02/T-IC-02) is for deterministic partition lenses and is applied to a stochastic compressed-likelihood lens BY ANALOGY (ledger MISSING-interface: no stochastic-lens backbone); the only Lean-certified piece is an elementary truncated-Gaussian boundary lemma the paper itself calls inessential. OPPOSITE-WORLD TEST FAILS DECISIVELY: the audit statistic is non-negative by construction and sign-blind, so a loosened bound, a flipped asymmetry, or a TE/EE localization would all be 'retrodicted' identically as a packaging-stability failure. Overfitting/flexibility risk: HIGH. The one mitigating fact is genuine cross-fact mechanism reuse (mechanism_tag=route-mismatch, shared with the dark-energy apparent-acceleration retrodiction and a named SBT primitive), so the audit FORM is generic rather than bespoke -- but reuse of an audit form is not a predictive mechanism, and it forecasts nothing about m_nu. Net: a legitimate, non-trivial methodological repackaging with no cosmological information gain and no falsifiable content about the neutrino mass.

Opposite-world test fails decisively: a loosened bound, a flipped asymmetry (314 vs 2222), or a TE/EE-localized mismatch would each be narrated identically as a 'packaging-stability failure'. The mechanism cannot fail to fire whenever two releases differ. Zero falsifiable content about the neutrino mass.

The empirical content actually attributed to SBT-flavored novelty (TT high-ell ~2000-3000 localization, the reprocessing diagnostic) is explicitly imported from arXiv:2601.16277 with disclaimed novelty (line 238: 'we do not claim novelty'; line 385 reads the localization THROUGH the source). serious_objections: Magnitudes are not recovered: reproduced SPT2018 baseline 0.080 eV vs source ~0.11 eV (verified line 463), and the two baselines disagree on shift size (0.109 eV vs 0.012 eV in Table tab:mnu-shift, lines 423/428). The packaging-stability certificate (D-IC-02/T-IC-02) is proven only for DETERMINISTIC partition lenses; the candl compressed-likelihood object is a stochastic/compressed map. The ledger confirms 'No stochastic-lens backbone in the certified core'. The central 'certificate' is therefore applied by analogy, not discharged.

The reported Delta-chi^2 numbers (2222, 314, 860, 370) are raw -2 dlogL diagnostics, explicitly NOT calibrated p-values (verified line 263) and have no null distribution. High degrees of freedom (~9 adjustable choices) against essentially ONE matched fact (a sign). Overfitting/flexibility-saturation risk is high; nothing was pre-registered.

The crucial auxiliary assumption -- that a coherent package SHOULD be stable under the swap because it is 'nearly the same sky' -- is asserted, not derived.
